title: Pregnancy Recipes: Iron-and-Folate Bowls You Can Cook in 30 Minutes
excerpt: Three tasty recipes pairing heme/non-heme iron with vitamin C — Vietnamese-inspired bowls with clear portions and food-safety notes.
content:
## Introduction
During pregnancy, it's essential to provide the body with sufficient iron and folate. Iron helps create red blood cells, while folate supports the development of the fetus. However, finding recipes rich in iron and folate can be a challenge. In this article, we'll introduce three simple and delicious recipes that combine iron with vitamin C, helping pregnant women have a nutritious and safe meal.

## Recipe 1: Grilled Chicken and Vegetable Bowl with Lime
* 100g grilled chicken (iron: 1.5mg)
* 100g steamed vegetables (folate: 100mcg)
* 1 lime (vitamin C: 50mg)
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* Note: Choose chicken that's cooked thoroughly and vegetables that are washed clean to ensure food safety.

## Recipe 2: Baked Salmon and Spinach Bowl with Bell Pepper
* 100g baked salmon (iron: 1.2mg)
* 100g steamed spinach (folate: 150mcg)
* 1 bell pepper (vitamin C: 100mg)
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* Note: Choose salmon that's cooked thoroughly and spinach that's washed clean to ensure food safety.

## Recipe 3: Beef and Vegetable Stir-Fry Bowl with Tomato
* 100g beef stir-fry (iron: 2.5mg)
* 100g steamed vegetables (folate: 200mcg)
* 1 tomato (vitamin C: 20mg)
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* Note: Choose beef that's cooked thoroughly and vegetables that are washed clean to ensure food safety.

## Food Safety Notes
During pregnancy, women should avoid eating:
* Raw or undercooked foods
* Foods containing listeria
* Foods high in mercury
* For more information on food safety during pregnancy, visit our [pregnancy food safety](/blog/topics/pregnancy-food-safety) page.

## Conclusion
The three recipes above are excellent choices for pregnant women who want to provide their bodies with sufficient iron and folate. With simple and easy-to-find ingredients, pregnant women can easily prepare nutritious and safe meals. For more information on prenatal nutrition and other recipes, visit our [pregnancy meal planner](/planner) page.

To learn more about pregnancy nutrition and meal planning, you can also visit our [prenatal nutrition category](/blog/topics/prenatal-nutrition) page, which features a range of articles and recipes to support a healthy pregnancy.
